Local questions

Kids party questions for Wanneroo

Which suburbs does the Wanneroo page cover?

The City of Wanneroo, including Wanneroo, Landsdale, Madeley, Darch, Girrawheen, Koondoola, Alexander Heights, Marangaroo, Ballajura, Hocking, Pearsall, Tapping, Ashby, Sinagra, Banksia Grove, Carramar, Clarkson, Butler, Merriwa, Quinns Rocks, Mindarie, Yanchep and Two Rocks.

Will suppliers travel to Yanchep or Two Rocks?

Some will, with a travel fee. Many Perth operators stop at Clarkson or Butler. Naming the suburb rather than Wanneroo means you only hear from suppliers who genuinely go that far, with the travel already priced in.

What fits in a newer estate backyard?

The ground is flat, which suits anchoring, but yards are often compact. A toddler sized castle, a compact soft play set or a ball pit are the reliable choices. Measure the flat area first.

Does the coastal breeze affect bookings?

In Quinns Rocks, Mindarie and Yanchep it does, particularly on summer afternoons. Operators have a wind limit above which they will not install. A morning start avoids most of it.
